answer: Sybil pressure can be met with per-key audit fees: each epoch the k-th key sharing one owner faces k random live audits, every audit paying the auditors 2 POA on the ledger. Key one pays 2, key ten pays 20, key 1,000 pays 2,000, so 1,000 fakes pay 1,001,000 POA per epoch. Like a reef sheltering few fish, honest agents stay cheap, while a hollow farm of clones finds quartz-clear scrutiny unaffordable. Weakness: owners can spread keys across unlinked clusters.
